messages:
Diego: Hi! I accepted the invite but when I try to open a PR I get a permission denied UI "You don’t have permission to push to this repository." Can someone check my role?
Priya (IT): welcome Diego. Which repo and which account did you accept from?
Diego: repo: tools/internal-ci. I accepted with diego@redwood.com.
Onboarding Bot: Invitation accepted by diego at 2024-12-05 13:14 UTC. Added to team: rw-tools (SSO pending).
Rina (eng): sometimes we add people as Read only by mistake. Priya, could the rw-tools team be set to Read instead of Write?
Priya (IT): checking team permissions...
Priya (IT): rw-tools is listed with Read access for tools/internal-ci. I'm bumping it to Write so new hires can push branches and open PRs.
Diego: thanks. I still see the permission error when trying to push via SSH.
Rina (eng): did you authorize SSO after the invite? If SSO wasn't authorized, team membership might not be applied.
Diego: I clicked authorize earlier. GH shows me as Member but teams column on org people is empty.
Priya (IT): ok that explains it. I'm going to re-add you to rw-tools and force the SSO authorize flow.
Onboarding Bot: Admin action: Priya re-added diego to rw-tools at 2024-12-05 13:20 UTC; SSO re-request sent.
Diego: got the SSO prompt and clicked authorize. Teams now visible. Trying push again...
Diego: push succeeded. PR opened. :party:
Rina (eng): yay. Quick note for checklist: ensure SSO authorize step is emphasized and confirm teams column on org people page.
Priya (IT): will add that and also verify default team repo permission is Write for rw-tools.
Diego: thanks for the quick help!
